……ふう、なんとか逃げ切れましたわね。\nここまで来れば、きっと大丈夫ですわ。: ...Phew, we somehow managed to escape. We should be safe here.
……つ、疲れました……はぁ、はぁ……\nそ、それでいったい何が……: ...I-I'm so exhausted... Haa, haa... S-So, what on earth was all that...?
ごめんなさい、巻き込んでしまいましたわね……\nあの方々に捕まってしまうと大変か: I am so sorry for dragging you into this... I figured it would be terrible if we were caught by them...
そ、そうですね……残されてたらどうなってたか……: Y-You're right... I wonder what would have happened to me if I was left behind...
ですが、わたくしの事情に巻き込んでしまいましたから、\n本当にごめんなさいね。: Even so, I truly am sorry for involving you in my personal affairs.
いえ、気にしないでください！: No, please don't worry about it!
あらためて自己紹介をさせてくださいませ。\nわたくしの名前は、鳴滝七彩ですわ。: Allow me to introduce myself properly. My name is Nanairo Narutaki.
鳴滝七彩さん……とっても素敵なお名前ですね！\n私は桃園めるって言います！: Nanairo Narutaki-san... That's such a lovely name! I'm Meru Momozono!
桃園めるさん……ああ、覚えていますわ！: Meru Momozono-san... Ah, I remember you!
えっ、どこかで会いましたっけ？: Eh, have we met somewhere before?
基礎課程の授業で何度か見かけましたわ。\nとても集中して授業を受けていましたし…: I saw you several times during the basic training classes. You were paying attention with such intense concentration...
集中しすぎて先生の話をちゃんと聞かずに、\n注意されていましたから記憶に残ってい: You were so focused that you failed to listen to the instructor's lecture properly and got scolded, which made you quite memorable.
それで、めるさんはどうしてあそこに？: By the way, Meru-san, why were you over there?
実はその……まだチームが見つかっていませんので、\nどうしようかと思っていまして: Actually, um... I haven't found a team yet, so I was wondering what to do...
はい、色んな所でチームに体験で入れてもらったんですが……\nどこも断られてしまっ: Yes, I got to try out for various teams on a trial basis, but... every single one turned me down...
このままだとどこにも入れてもらえなくて……\n退学になっちゃうかもしれません……: If this keeps up and no one takes me in... I might get expelled...
七彩さんはどうして追いかけられていたんですか？: Why were you being chased, Nanairo-san?
その、わたくしは鳴滝重工……知っているかもしれませんが、\nＭＧメーカーの一人娘: Well, I am the only daughter of the head of Narutaki Heavy Industries... an MG manufacturer you might have heard of.
えっ！ あ、た、確かにそういえば聞いたことあります！\n七彩さん、凄い人だったん: Eh! A-Ah, come to think of it, I definitely have heard of them! You're an incredible person, Nanairo-san!
わたくしじゃなくて、わたくしの実家が凄いだけですわ。\nそれが理由で、ああいった: It is not me who is remarkable, but merely my family's business. That is the reason I receive invitations like those.
……わたくしのことはいいですわ。\nそれで、どんなチームに入りたいんですの？: ...Enough about me. More importantly, what kind of team do you wish to join?
どういうチーム、ですか？ えっと……: What kind of team, you ask? Umm...
チームの皆と仲良く協力して、頑張ることが出来る……\nそんなパイロットチームに入: A pilot team where everyone can get along, cooperate with each other, and do our best... That's the kind of team I want to join!
ふふ、フワッとした条件ですわね: Fufu, those are rather vague requirements.
……めるさんに一つ聞いてみたいのですが、\nあなたはどうしてパイロットになったの: ...May I ask you something, Meru-san? Why did you decide to become a pilot?
どうして……ですか？\n……それは、誰かの役に立ちたいからです！: Why... did I? ...That's because I want to be useful to someone!
はい！ その……私は昔から色んな人に迷惑をかけて……\nだから、誰かの役に立ちた: Yes! Um... I've caused trouble for so many people in the past... That's why I've always wanted to be helpful to others.
パイロットになれば、たくさんの人を助けられるから……\nだから、私はパイロットに: If I become a pilot, I can save a lot of people... So I came to this academy to become a pilot!
……なるほど。\nそれがめるさんのパイロットになった理由ですか。: ...I see. So that is your reason for becoming a pilot, Meru-san.
……もしよければですけども。\nめるさん、私とチームを組みませんか？: ...If you do not mind, Meru-san... would you like to form a team with me?
ええ、そうですわ。\n桃園めるさんとチームを組みたいと思ったのです。: Yes, exactly. I want to form a team with you, Meru Momozono-san.
で、でも！ 私って成績もあんまりですし……！: B-But! Objectively speaking, my grades aren't even that good...!
成績が悪いのなら、これから勉強をしていけばいいですわ。: If your grades are poor, then we can simply study together from now on.
集中すると、周りが見えなくなっちゃいますし……！: When I focus, I lose sight of my surroundings...!
それなら、集中して活躍できるように、\nチームで考えていけばいいんですわ。: In that case, we can simply work out a strategy as a team so you can unleash your strength while staying focused.
めるさん……そんなに自分を貶めなくてもいいですわ。: Meru-san... there is no need to put yourself down so much.
わたくしは、話を聞いて……あなたの人となりを知って、\n同じチームを組みたいと思: After hearing your story and learning what kind of person you are, I decided that I want to be on the same team as you.
……ほ、本当に私でいいんですか……？: ...A-Are you really sure you want me...?
ええ。わたくしの求めるような、\nわたくしの力を必要とするパイロットチームに空き: Yes. There are no vacant spots in the pilot teams that meet my criteria and genuinely require my skills.
おそらく今後も探すとしても……\n下手なチームではわたくしの実家を頼りにしてしま: Even if I were to keep looking... mediocre teams would inevitably end up relying on my family background.
それであれば、わたくしと同じ志を持つ方と一緒に、\n新しいチームを作る方がいいと: If so, I felt it would be far better to start a new team together with someone who shares my ambitions.
めるさんは、わたくしが鳴滝重工の娘と知っても、\n尊敬はしても頼ろうとはしません: Even after learning I was the daughter of Narutaki Heavy Industries, you respected it without trying to lean on it.
それに、真面目に悩んで本気で誰かの役に立とうと考える。\nそんな気持ちは、きっと: Furthermore, you earnestly struggle and genuinely want to help others. A heart like that is truly irreplaceable.
それに、もう一つ理由がありますわ。: Plus, there is one more reason.
わたくしも皆と仲良く協力出来るパイロットチームで、\n一緒に頑張りたいのは同意で: I also completely agree that I want to work hard in a pilot team where everyone can get along and cooperate with each other.
それで、わたくしの申し出の返答はいかがかしら？: So, how would you answer my proposal?
……ありがとございます！\n初めて、こんな風に必要だって言って貰えました。: ...Thank you so much! This is the first time anyone has ever told me I was needed like this.
だから……そんな七彩さんと一緒に、チームを組みたいです！\nだから、よろしくお願: That's why... I want to form a team with you, Nanairo-san! So please, look after me!
ええ！ それでは今日からよろしくお願いしますわ！: Yes! I look forward to working with you from today onward!
……とはいえ、二人だけだとチームとして認められませんね。: ...That said, just two of us won't be officially recognized as a team.
そうですわね……特別な実績や実力のないわたくしたちでは、\n五人メンバーがなけれ: Indeed... Without any special achievements or exceptional track records, our application will likely be rejected unless we have five members...
残り三人のメンバーを見つけるのが急務ですわね。: It seems finding three more members is an urgent priority.
はい！ これから頑張りましょう！: Yes! Let's do our best from now on!
ええ！ それじゃあ、今からチームメンバー探しを――: Yes! Well then, let's start searching for team members right—
な、なにが、何が起きたんですかぁ！？\nいきなりドーンって！: W-What, what on earth happened?! There was a sudden BOOM!
え、ええっと……わたくしもなにがなんだか。\n背後の教室が爆発したような……: U-Umm... I have no idea what just happened either. It seems like the classroom behind us just exploded...
けほけほ……\nいやー、失敗失敗: Cough, cough... Man, total failure, total failure!
いやあ、まさか爆発するなんてねぇ……\n圧力を加え過ぎたのが悪かったのかな……？: Geez, I didn't think it would actually explode... Maybe applying too much pressure was a bad idea...?
そこの貴方！ いったい何事ですの！？: You over there! What in the world was that?!
ん？ もしかして爆発に巻き込んじゃったかな？\nごめんごめん。: Hmm? Did you guys get caught in the blast? Sorry, sorry!
ごめんで済むような話じゃありませんわ！\nまず、何をしていましたの！？: A simple 'sorry' isn't going to cut it! First of all, what were you doing?!
こんな学園で爆発させるような危険な実験なんて……！: Conducting dangerous experiments that cause explosions inside the academy grounds...!
いやいや、これもちゃんとした実験なんだよね。\nメイズ由来の物質に圧力をかけたら: No, no, this is a legitimate experiment! I was testing what happens when you apply pressure to a material originating from the Maze.
……その結果が爆発ですの？: ...And the end result was an explosion?!
いやあ、もうちょっと小規模な爆発になるはずだったんだけど、\n面倒くさくて放置し: Well, it was supposed to be a much smaller blast, but it accidentally set off a sympathetic detonation in some other stuff I was too lazy to clear away.
慌てて隠れたから無事だったんだけど、\nここまでのことになるなんてねー！: I scrambled for cover so I'm completely fine, but man, I didn't think it'd turn into this big of a deal!
自業自得じゃありませんか！？: That's entirely your own fault, isn't it?!
……あれ？ 誰かが来る足音が聞こえませんか？: ...Huh? Don't you hear footsteps coming this way?
爆発音がしたなら当然ですわ。: That is only natural after a loud explosion.
……はぁ。柊校舎の爆発騒ぎ……\nやはり犯人は貴方ですか。: ...Haaah. The explosion commotion in the Hiiragi building... So the culprit is you again.
幾ら爆発が起きたからと言って、\nなぜ神楽生徒会長がこんな場所にまで……！？: Even if an explosion went off, why is Kagura, the Student Council President, all the way out here...?!
ごめんごめん、うっかりしちゃって。\nとはいえ、実験に失敗はつきものだからね！: My bad, my bad, it was an honest mistake. Though, failure is just a part of experimentation, right!
……そういって今回で何回目か覚えていますか？: ...Do you remember how many times you've said that by now?
何回だっけ？\n……２回目くらい？: How many times was it again? ...Like, the second time?
生徒会に苦情が入ってきた回数だけで６回です。\nあくまでも苦情が入った回数ですか: The number of complaints received by the student council alone is six. And that is strictly counting official complaints.
爆発以外にも異臭騒ぎや、実験による騒音。\n他にも多種多様な種類の苦情が届いてい: In addition to explosions, there have been foul odor incidents and noise from experiments. A wide variety of other complaints have reached us.
流石にこれ以上は私でも庇えません。\nせめてパイロットとして実績を出していれば別: Even I cannot cover for you any further than this. Unless, of course, you had at least produced results as a pilot.
ええ～？ パイロット活動をしてたら、\n実験とかに使える時間が減っちゃうじゃん！: Ehhh～? If I do pilot work, that'll cut into the time I can spend on my experiments!
……むしろこちらとしては願ったり叶ったりですが。\nですので、これは最終通告とな: ...That would actually be ideal from our perspective. Therefore, this serves as your final warning.
パイロットとしての務めを果たせないのであれば、\n退学処理と致しましょう。: If you cannot fulfill your duties as a pilot, we will proceed with your expulsion.
……なんだかすごい現場に遭遇していますわね。: ...We seem to have stumbled upon quite an intense scene.
うう、もう何が何だか……: Ugh, I have no idea what's going on anymore...
ううん……それは困ったなぁ。\nここで退学にされるわけにもいかないし……: Hmm... That's a real problem. I can't afford to get expelled here...
……んー、それなら仕方ないなぁ！\nそっちの子達とチームを組むから！: ...Mmm, guess I have no choice then! I'll just form a team with those girls over there!
まだ人数が足りてないんだよね？\nなら、人手は欲しいんじゃないかな～？: You guys are still short on members, right? So I figured you could use an extra hand～?
うう……よろしくお願いします……: Ugh... Please be good to me...
もしかして実験をしながら聞いていましたの！？\nめ、めるさん！ どう致しますか！: Were you eavesdropping on us while conducting your experiment?! M-Meru-san! What should we do!
ああ！？ もしかしてまだ混乱していますの！？\nめるさん！ しっかりしてください: Ah?! Are you still in a state of confusion?! Meru-san! Please pull yourself together!
ふむ、なるほど……\n確かにそれであればこちらからは文句はありません。: Hmm, I see... Indeed, if that is the case, the student council has no objections.
ですが、５人には人数が足りないようですね。\nあなたのやらかしを考えれば……明日: However, you still lack enough members to reach five. Considering the mess you have caused... I will give you a deadline until tomorrow.
ええ～！？ もうちょっと余裕はないの～！？: Ehhh～?! Can't you give us a bit more time～?!
ありません。何度目だと思っているのですか。: No. How many times do you think we have been through this?
……ええっと、わたくしたちはどうすれば？: ...Umm, what are we supposed to do?
何が何だか分からないうちに、色々と決まっていきます……: Things are being decided left and right before I can even process anything...
――譲歩は出来ません。\n明日までにメンバーを揃えて生徒会に提出をすること。良い: —There will be no concessions. Gather your members and submit your application to the student council by tomorrow. Is that clear?
ちぇー、分かったよ。\nきっかり揃えてくるからねー！: Tch, fine, fine! I'll make sure we have everyone ready right on time～!
……勝手に時間制限まで付けられてしまいましたわ。: ...She just went ahead and let a time limit be slapped on us.
さて……聞くのが遅れましたが、\n貴方たちはそれでよいのですか？: Now then... I apologize for asking late, but are the two of you truly fine with this?
いえ、わたくし達はこの方とはなんの関係も……: No, we have absolutely no relation to this person...
お願い、キミ達に断られたら、あたし、退学になっちゃうんだ。\nだから……ね？ 私: Please! If you reject me, I'm gonna get expelled! So... pretty please? Let me join your team too, I'm begging you!
自分で言うのもなんだけど、あたし、\n結構役に立つと思うんだけどな～……: If I do say so myself, I think I can be pretty useful, you know～...
同意が得られていないのならば、\nパイロットになる意思は認められないということで: If consent cannot be obtained, then we cannot recognize her intention to become a pilot, which means—
だって、チームに入れないと、\nこの人が退学になっちゃいますし……本当に困ってま: Because if we don't let her join, she'll end up getting expelled... and she's genuinely in trouble...
……わかりました。では、意思の確認は取れました。\nそれでは明日までに5人のメン: ...Very well. Your intent has been confirmed. Please gather all five members and submit your application by tomorrow.
あと２人集めればいいんでしょ？\nオッケー、楽勝楽勝♪: We just need to find two more, right? Got it, piece of cake♪
そ、そんなに楽勝ですかね……？: I-Is it really going to be that easy...?
ちなみにですが……そちらのお二人は、\n月ヶ瀬ちゆるさんに協力したという事で一蓮: As a side note... since you two have agreed to cooperate with Chiyuru Tsukigase-san, you share the exact same fate now.
人数が揃わなかった時には連帯責任として、\nおふたりも処分を受けてもらいますので: If you fail to gather enough members, as a matter of joint responsibility, you two will also face punishment. Keep that in mind.
